title: QA Engineer – Mobile Testing
description:
We are looking for a QA Engineer with a strong focus on mobile testing to join our team. The SBC App Team within the Specialized Global Tech unit is responsible for building and supporting mobile applications that enhance the rider experience for e-bikes. The QA Engineer will ensure the overall quality and functionality of our mobile applications by implementing mobile testing strategies, leveraging both manual and automated frameworks.

Role Summary

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience testing mobile applications at scale, ideally within the cycling or connected device industry. They will demonstrate a deep understanding of QA best practices while knowing when to apply flexibility. They will possess strong technical skills to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve mobile-specific issues. A passion for test automation is essential, with proven experience in successful implementations.

How You’ll Make a Difference

  • Review mobile app requirements and designs to assess testability.
  • Author mobile-focused test plans and develop test scripts with technical documentation.
  • Design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases for Android and iOS using Katalon and Appium.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, and stress testing on mobile devices and emulators.
  • Collaborate with developers, UX/UI, and product teams to resolve issues and improve mobile app quality.
  • Identify, document, and manage mobile defects within our in-house bug tracking system.
  • Ensure QA processes for mobile test environments are followed and maintain the integrity of those environments.
  • Review ticket requirements, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria to create and execute test cases within sprints.
  • Manage UAT for mobile apps with business users, UX/UI, and development teams.
  • Analyze test results and effectively communicate outcomes to the broader team.

What You'll Need To Win

  • 5+ years’ experience in Software Quality Assurance and testing.
  • 3+ years’ experience in mobile application testing (iOS and Android).
  • Hands-on experience with Katalon Studio or Appium for test automation.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile QA processes, testing methodologies, and mobile testing tools.
  • Experience with Xcode, Android Studio, and device/emulator-based testing.
  • Understanding of REST APIs, native mobile applications, and connected hardware integrations.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills in mobile contexts.
  • Experience with developing and documenting clear test plans and cases for mobile applications.
  • Self-learner with excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Experience with Atlassian Confluence and JIRA.

Bonus Experience

  • Performance and security testing for mobile apps.
  • Additional hands-on experience with other mobile automation frameworks (Espresso, XCTest, etc.).

title: Backend QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend QA Engineer based in Switzerland.
As a Backend QA Engineer, you will take ownership of software quality across a high-traffic backend platform, ensuring reliable performance and seamless transaction processing. You will combine hands-on manual testing with automated test development to identify defects early and prevent issues from reaching production. Working closely with engineering teams, you will validate complex transaction lifecycles, API integrations, and event-driven workflows across distributed services. You will develop and maintain automated test suites using TypeScript and Playwright while strengthening regression coverage and testing efficiency. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing B2B technology platform within a dynamic, international, fully remote environment. Your analytical mindset and attention to detail will help establish robust quality practices as the platform scales.
Accountabilities
Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories to design comprehensive test cases, scenarios, and validation strategies.
Perform end-to-end testing of transaction lifecycles, including initiation, authorization, settlement, and reconciliation, ensuring accuracy and consistency across the platform.
Proactively explore the system to identify edge cases, unexpected behaviors, potential risks, and defects that may not be covered by documented requirements.
Develop, maintain, and improve automated regression test suites using TypeScript and Playwright, prioritizing critical business workflows and high-risk functionality.
Automate API testing and validate REST and gRPC endpoints using tools such as Postman, grpcurl, or equivalent solutions.
Test event-driven architectures and message-based workflows involving technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or NATS, including retry mechanisms, duplicate message handling, and failure scenarios.
Execute regression testing following deployments, combining automated and manual testing wherever automation coverage remains incomplete.
Document, report, and track defects in Jira, providing clear reproduction steps, relevant request payloads, service logs, and supporting evidence.
Validate data consistency across backend services using SQL queries and database checks when necessary.
Collaborate with backend developers and other stakeholders to investigate defects, verify fixes, improve test coverage, and strengthen overall software quality.
Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, testing standards, and automation practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
Requirements
At least four years of professional experience in manual and automated software testing.
Hands-on experience in the iGaming industry, with exposure to areas such as online slots, bonuses, sportsbook products, or payment systems.
Practical experience developing automated tests using TypeScript and Playwright.
Experience with API testing and automation, including tools such as Postman, as well as test management platforms such as TestRail or Zephyr.
Working knowledge of Docker and the ability to run and configure services locally for testing purposes.
Solid understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies, software testing principles, and the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
Good conversational English skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with distributed engineering teams.
Willingness to perform manual testing when needed, maintaining a balanced approach between exploratory testing and automation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with meticulous attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying risks.
Familiarity with Go or the ability to read and understand Go code is an advantage.
Basic SQL knowledge and the ability to query relational databases to validate data integrity are desirable.
Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders is a plus.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and automated testing integration is beneficial.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, observability tools, and monitoring practices is an advantage.
Understanding of microservices architectures and distributed backend systems is desirable.
A collaborative mindset, a sense of ownership, and the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment are important for success.
Benefits
Fully remote work: Work remotely from eligible locations across Europe, with flexibility to organize your working environment.
Generous time off: Take up to 28 unavailable days per year, in addition to public holidays.

Technical ownership: Help shape quality assurance practices, strengthen automation coverage, and contribute to the platform's development as it scales.
Professional growth: Gain hands-on experience with backend testing, transaction processing, API automation, and event-driven architectures.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) ID51745
description:
• Love writing Python code that makes complex things work seamlessly?
  • Enjoy building automation frameworks, solving tricky technical problems and finding smarter ways to test software?
  • Want to take ownership of automation improvements and have a real say in how testing is done?


If that sounds like you, this could be a brilliant next move.


Our client is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join their growing engineering team in Oxford.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys the development side of test automation. You'll be working with an established Python-based framework, finding ways to make it faster, more reliable and easier to maintain, while helping to shape the team's approach to software quality.


It's a role where your ideas will be valued, your technical skills will be put to good use and you'll have the freedom to make meaningful improvements.


Why This Role is Great

If you enjoy getting stuck into code, improving how things work and seeing the results of your efforts, there's plenty here to get excited about.

  • Make automation your own: Play a key role in developing and enhancing an existing Python automation framework, using tools such as Selenium and Behave.
  • Build things that last: Create reusable libraries, utilities and testing solutions that make life easier for developers and testers alike.
  • Solve the interesting problems: Investigate flaky tests, tackle performance bottlenecks and find ways to make automated testing more stable and efficient.
  • Shape how testing is done: Bring fresh ideas to automation architecture, coding standards and best practices, helping the team continuously improve.
  • Automate more, manually test less: Identify opportunities to expand automation coverage and streamline testing processes.
  • Get involved in the bigger picture: Work with CI/CD pipelines, test reporting and development workflows to make quality an integral part of software delivery.
  • Share what you know: Support and mentor other engineers, helping to develop technical skills and encourage an automation-first mindset.
  • Keep developing your expertise: Gain exposure to structured quality processes and further strengthen your approach to building reliable, well-tested software.


This is an opportunity to do more than maintain automated tests. You'll help influence how automation evolves and contribute to the wider engineering team's success.


About You

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys writing code, understands what makes a great automation framework and likes finding better ways to solve technical challenges.


You'll have the chance to build on your existing experience with:

  • Python: Writing clean, maintainable and reusable code, using object-oriented programming principles and good software design practices.
  • Test automation: Developing and maintaining automated test frameworks using Selenium, Playwright or similar tools.
  • BDD frameworks: Working with Behave or comparable behaviour-driven testing approaches.
  • Automation design: Applying patterns such as Page Object Model (POM) to create well-structured, scalable test suites.
  • API testing: Building automated API tests using Python Requests or equivalent libraries.
  • CI/CD and version control: Using Git and tools such as GitLab CI to support efficient development and testing workflows.
  • Problem-solving: Debugging unreliable tests, identifying root causes and improving test performance.
  • Test insights: Using logging, reporting and test analysis to understand results and drive improvements.


You'll enjoy collaborating with other engineers, sharing knowledge and taking a proactive approach to technical challenges.


A Few Extras That Would Be Great

If you've also worked with any of the following, that's a bonus:

  • Docker and containerised environments.
  • Linux command-line tools.
  • AWS or other cloud platforms.
  • Allure or similar test reporting tools.
  • Test data management and environment configuration.
  • Automated testing within deployment pipelines.
  • Formal software quality, verification or validation processes.


Don't have experience with everything listed? That's absolutely fine.

If you're confident with Python, have a solid background in automation and enjoy learning new technologies, our client would be keen to hear from you.


What's in It for You?

This is a great opportunity for an engineer who wants to have a genuine impact rather than simply work through a testing checklist.

You'll get the chance to:

  • Take ownership of technical improvements and help guide automation development.
  • Work with modern engineering tools and explore new ways to improve testing efficiency.
  • Develop your technical depth in Python, automation architecture and CI/CD.
  • Influence best practices and contribute ideas that make a difference.
  • Grow your leadership skills through mentoring and knowledge sharing.
  • Work on technically interesting software where quality, performance and reliability are important.


You'll be joining a team that values thoughtful engineering, continuous improvement and people who enjoy solving problems.


Ready for Your Next Challenge?

Whether you're currently a Software Development Engineer in Test, Python Automation Engineer, Automation Test Engineer or Software Engineer with a passion for testing, we'd love to hear from you.

If you enjoy building robust automation solutions, improving frameworks and making software better, this could be exactly the opportunity you've been looking for.


Apply today to learn more about this SDET opportunity in Oxford.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences, including those with transferable skills who may not meet every preferred requirement.
